crossRefs.note: You shall surely tithe all the increase of your seed, that which comes out of the field year by year.
When you have finished tithing all the tithe of your increase in the third year, which is the year of tithing, then you…
“Go to Bethel, and sin; to Gilgal, and sin more. Bring your sacrifices every morning, your tithes every three days,

translations.web: At the end of every three years you shall bring all the tithe of your increase in the same year, and shall store it within your gates.
translations.bsb: At the end of every three years, bring a tenth of all your produce for that year and lay it up within your gates.
translations.kjv: At the end of three years thou shalt bring forth all the tithe of thine increase the same year, and shalt lay it up within thy gates:
translations.asv: At the end of every three years thou shalt bring forth all the tithe of thine increase in the same year, and shalt lay it up within thy gates:
